name: Bulge
author: E. T. Carter
description: One large glass lens enters from the right edge of a dark sheet of glowing print, blocks of dot-matrix type alternating with bands of fine ruled lines, while a small satellite lens drifts on its own path. Each lens refracts the sheet for real: the type magnifies at the centre, the rules bow into arcs and pile up at the rim, and a clear chromatic split opens where the glass steepens; a fresnel rim, a studio highlight, gathered light under the glass, a contact shadow and a thin caustic ring seat the lenses on the page.

params.label: Bulge
params.effect: Height of the glass dome against its radius; low is a shallow watch-glass, high is a near hemisphere with a violent rim.

params.label: Lens size
params.effect: Radius of the large lens as a fraction of the frame height; the satellite lens scales with it.

params.label: Travel speed
params.effect: How fast the lenses travel and the sheet scrolls; 0 holds everything still.

params.label: Chromatic split
params.effect: Difference in refractive index between the colour channels; 0 is achromatic glass, high fringes the whole rim.

params.label: Type size
params.effect: Width of a glyph cell in CSS pixels; low is fine dense print, high is large display type.
